INCIDENCE OF SUICIDE AMONG YOUTHS

     19.   Mdm Cynthia Phua asked the Minister for Education (a) what is the incidence of suicide among youths between 10 and 23 years old; (b) how many of these cases involved students; (c) how many of these suicide victims had seen their school counsellors before they ended their lives; and (d) what is the Ministry doing to reduce the suicide trend among students.

     Dr Ng Eng Hen:

     The incidence of suicide for all residents between ages 10 to 24 (1) years has not shown any increasing trend over the past few years. According to data from the birth and death registry of the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA), the incidence (2)  for this age group was 7.2 in 2003, 5.8 in 2004, 6.1 in 2005, 4.9 in 2006 and 6.7 in 2007. Among these, suicides involving students varied from 10 to 19 cases per year. The figures are given in Table 1:
